reasons.text: Energy charges do not match units x tariff on 100% of bills (worst bill charged 60% of expected)
Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 50% of months
Category III share of certificates is 38%, +36% versus what its process route can produce
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.73x the cost floor)
Shares a bank account with 1 other registered entity(ies)
28% of feedstock comes from collectors invoicing far beyond their declared capacity

inspection_checklist: Verify the electricity bills directly with the DISCOM (units, tariff, amount); the uploaded copies do not reconcile.
Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
Compare the plant against the entities sharing its identifiers (bank, address, director, photos); consider a joint inspection.
Visit the named collectors: confirm premises, vehicles and storage; check their registration dates and sales to other buyers.
